questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Highway changes ahead and to the right.
Hiking trails ahead and to the right.
Hotel ahead and to the right.
Hospital ahead and to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hospital ahead and to the right.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a hospital with emergency services is located to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts drivers that traffic is moving in both directions. You may encounter vehicles coming toward you from the opposite direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill is coming ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals show your intentions to other drivers. When the left arm is bent at the elbow and points upward, it means you are turning right or changing lanes to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a T-shaped intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must travel at the speed indicated.
The maximum legal speed on the roadway is 55 mph.
You must travel through the intersection at the posted speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum legal speed on the roadway is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This speed limit sign shows the highest speed you can legally drive on this road. In bad weather or poor conditions, you should drive slower than the posted limit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: An upcoming curve in the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: An upcoming curve in the road.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road curves to the right ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always stop, whether there’s a stop sign or not.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always sound your horn when you see children.
Be ready to help children crossing the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Always give the right of way to pedestrians in crosswalks. Stay alert for pedestrians, especially when turning or crossing intersections.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.
Come to a complete stop before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: If you see this sign, you are going the wrong way on a one-way street. This puts you at risk of a head-on collision. Turn around carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a traffic signal is coming. Slow down and be prepared to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Construction workers on or near the roadway.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow backgrounds and black markings. They warn drivers about hazards ahead. This sign tells you that pedestrians may be crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to road conditions and hazards ahead. This sign warns you that a stop sign is coming. Prepare to stop completely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Riders use hand signals instead of turn signals. When a rider's left arm is bent upward at the elbow, it means they plan to turn right or change lanes to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane ends or roadway narrows ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane ends or roadway narrows ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow backgrounds and black markings. They warn drivers about hazards ahead. This sign tells you the right lane is ending or the road is getting narrower.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped signs are only used to mark no passing zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to road conditions and hazards ahead. This sign warns you that traffic may enter from a side road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is approaching.
Look both ways as you cross the intersection.
Always come to a full stop at the intersection.
Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.
questions.explanation: Slow down as you approach a yield sign. Be ready to stop and let other vehicles and pedestrians go first. You must stop if traffic conditions require it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must bear either right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must bear either right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a Y intersection ahead. You must choose to go right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a crossroad is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep downhill section is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
Specific turning movements are allowed from specific lanes.
Drivers in both lanes are responsible for merging smoothly.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
questions.explanation: This is a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane sign. These lanes are for buses and cars with multiple passengers as shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an overpass ahead has low clearance. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must drive slowly and sound your horn.
You are entering a school's parking lot.

questions.explanation: This warning sign is yellow with black markings. It tells drivers to slow down and watch for children near a school.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay to the right side of the divider ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead has multiple turns and curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: May pass a slow-moving vehicle if you can do so quickly.
May pass if you know the road ahead.
May pass, but only at night.

questions.explanation: This is a regulatory sign with white background and black markings. Drivers must follow all rules on regulatory signs. This sign prohibits passing other vehicles.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic flows only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic flows only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This one-way sign shows that traffic can only move in the direction of the arrow.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulatory sign controls traffic movement and rules. It means left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a person is ahead controlling traffic in a construction zone.
